name: chess_puzzle_benchmark
description: A dataset of chess puzzles intended to evaluate a model's ability to find the correct chess move(s) from a given position. Tasks typically require producing the best move or sequence in algebraic notation and are scored by matching the correct solution(s). It is aimed at measuring reasoning and game-playing proficiency rather than natural-language understanding.
reputation: Small community dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use for evaluating chess-solving ability of language models.
